chapter.verse: Tua ahih manin khansiatna namkim leh mikhemna, puatham kineihna, hazatna leh gendaina nam khempeuh paaikhia un,
Naungek suakcilte bangin kha nawitui siang lunggulh un. Tua in hotkhiatna dong ah hong khangliansak ding hi.
Tua pen Topa hoih ahihlam a ciam khin takpi na hih uhleh cihna ahi hi.
Mite' nilkhiat himah taleh Pasian' muhna ah teeltuam leh a manpha suangtum hing ahi Topa' kiang na zuat uh ciangin

note a siangtho siampi nam ahi dingin leh Jesu Khris tungtawnin Pasian' kiangah a santaak kha biakpiaknate a luui dingin note mahmah suangtum hingte bang danin kha innpi khat ahi dingin hong kilam ahi hi.
A hang pen Pasian' Laibu sungah hih bangin kihel hi: “En un, Zion ah suangtum khat ka koih a, teeltuam leh a manpha sutpi ahi hi. Amah a um peuhpeuh maizumna tuakkha lo ding hi.”
Tua ahih manin no a umte' adingin pahtawina hi a, a umlo mite' ading ahihleh hih bang ahi hi: “Innlamte' nilkhiat suangtum, khuambul suangpi suak khinta hi.”
Tua banah, “Palkhaktheih suangtum khat leh puktheihna suangpi ahi hi.” Amaute a pukna uh pen a tuaci dinga kisehkhol ahih mah bangin thu a zuih lohna uh hang ahi hi.

Ahi zongin khuamial sungpan ama' khuavak a lamdang sungah a hong samkhia ama' hoihna phatnate na tangkokhiat theih nadingun note pen teeltuam minam, kumpi tawh kikop siampi nam, a siangtho minam, ama' neihsa mipawl na hi uh hi.
Note pen hun khat lai-in mipawl na hikei uh a, tu-in ahihleh Pasian' mipawl na hi uh hi; hun khat lai-in khualna thupha na ngah kei uh a, tu-in ahihleh khualna thupha na ngah ta uh hi.
Kong itte aw, khualmi leh pemta na hihna uh tawh na nunna kha uh gal bangin hong sim ahi cilesa lunggulhnate na kidek ding uh kong hanthawn hi.

Gentile mite' lakah na gamtat luhek uh a zahtak-huai hisak un. Tua hileh thusia bawlte ci-in hong gensiat uh ciangin nahoih na septe uh mu ding uh a, Pasian' hong hawh ni ciangin a min phat ding uh hi.
Topa' min na khualna-un mihing' phuh ukzawhna thu khempeuh' nuai-ah niamlut un. Mihing' phuh ukzawhna thu cih ciangin ukna sangpen ahi kumpipa zong hithei a,
kumpipa in thusia bawlte' tungah gawtna a pia dingin leh nahoih a semte' tungah pahtakna a lak dingin a sawl gam-uk uliante zong hithei hi.
A hang pen a hoihin gamtatna tawh mihaite' theihlahna na daihsak ding uh Pasian' deihna ahi hi.
Tualmi suaktate bangin nungta unla na suahtakna uh thusia seelna hisak lo-in Pasian' sila bangin nungta un.
Mi khempeuh thupisim un. Sanggampihte it un. Pasian kihta un. Kumpipa zahtak un.
Innsung nasemte aw, na tote uh lungsim hoih neite leh a thudikte bek hilo-in lungsim a kawite' nuai nangawn ah zahtakna lianpi tawh niamlut un.
A hang pen mi khat in thumaanlo thu a tuahkhak laitak Pasian phawkna tawh dahna teng a thuakzawh pen a pahtak-huai thu ahi hi.

A hang pen mawhna na bawl manun satna na tuah uhleh tua na thuakzawh uh pahtak nading thu om ahi hiam? Tua hilo-in nahoih na sep manun gimna na tuah uh-a tua na thuakzawh uhleh Pasian' muhna ah a pahtak-huai thu ahi hi.
A hang pen Khris zong note' adingin gimna a thuak hi a, ama' khekhap na zuih zawh nadingun etteh lim hong nusiat ahih mah bangin note pen tua bang dingin hong kisamkhia ahi hi.
Khris in mawhna bawl lo a, a kam panin zong zuau thu ging lo hi.
Kosiat a tuah laitak kuamah kosiakik lo, gimna a tuahkhak laitak kuamah lauphawn lo-in thu maantakin a khenpa' kiangah amahmah na ki-ap hi.
Eite, mawhna thu ah si-in diktatna thu ah a nungta i hih nadingin amahmah in singkhuam tungah a pumpi tawh i mawhnate pua hi. Ama' liammate hangin note hong kidamsak khin hi.
A hang pen note tuu bangin lampial na hih uh hangin tu-in ahihleh na nunna kha uh ii Tuucingpa leh Pawlpi Syapa' kiangah a kilehkik khinta na hi uh hi.
